source_text: Muhurta Chintamani (Rama Daivagya, trans. Girish Chand Sharma)

rules.heading: LORDS OF THE TITHIS

planetary.freeform: Lords of the tithis respectively are Agni, Brahma, Gauri, Ganesha, Sarpa, Kartikeya, Surya, Shiva, Durga, Yamaraja, Vishwe Deva, Vishnu, Kamadeva, Shiva, and Chandrama.

rules.notes: The text lists the presiding deities or lords for each of the fifteen tithis of both bright and dark fortnights.

rules.heading: THE LORDS OR DEITIES OF THE TITHIS
activities: establishing of the image with life

planetary.freeform: Worship, fasts, and Prana Pratishtha of a specific deity should be performed on the tithi presided over by that respective deity.

rules.notes: Perform worship, fasts, and idol consecration (Prana Pratishtha) of specific deities on their corresponding presiding tithis.

rules.heading: NANDA ETC. NAMES OF TITHIS AND SIDDHA YOGA

planetary.freeform: Tithis Nanda, Bhadra, Jaya, Rikta and Poorna falling in order on Friday, Wednesday, Tuesday, Saturday and Thursday form Siddha Yoga.

rules.notes: Siddha Yoga is formed when specific tithi groups coincide with designated weekdays in both bright and dark pakshas.

rules.heading: SIDDHA YOGA COMBINATIONS

planetary.freeform: Nanda on Friday, Bhadra on Wednesday, Jaya on Tuesday, Rikta on Saturday, Poorna on Thursday creates Siddha Yoga which destroys Muhurta defects like Masa Shunya and Masa Dagdha.

rules.notes: Specific combinations of tithi groups and weekdays form Siddha Yoga, which neutralizes various monthly Muhurta flaws.

rules.heading: AMRITA YOGA AND DAGDHA YOGA ON DAYS SUNDAY ETC.

planetary.freeform: Sunday with Nanda tithi, Monday with Bhadra tithi, Tuesday with Nanda tithi, Wednesday with Jaya tithi, Thursday with Rikta tithi, Friday with Bhadra tithi, Saturday with Poorna tithi

rules.notes: Amrita Yoga is formed when specific tithis coincide with specific weekdays (Sunday-Nanda, Monday-Bhadra, Tuesday-Nanda, Wednesday-Jaya, Thursday-Rikta, Friday-Bhadra, Saturday-Poorna).

rules.heading: AMRITA YOGA AND DAGDHA YOGA ON DAYS SUNDAY ETC. (DAGDHA YOGA)

planetary.freeform: Sunday with Bharani, Monday with Chitra, Tuesday with Uttarashadha, Wednesday with Dhanishtha, Thursday with Uttara Phalguni, Friday with Jyeshtha, Saturday with Revati

rules.notes: Dagdha Yoga is formed when specific nakshatras fall on specific weekdays (Sunday-Bharani, Monday-Chitra, Tuesday-Uttarashadha, Wednesday-Dhanishtha, Thursday-Uttara Phalguni, Friday-Jyeshtha, Saturday-Revati).

rules.heading: FORMATION OF YOGAS DUE TO TITHI, VARA, AND NAKSHATRA

planetary.freeform: Combination of specific weekdays, tithis, and nakshatras forming Siddha and Amrita yogas.

rules.notes: Certain combinations of weekdays and Poorna tithis form auspicious yogas like Amrita Yoga.

rules.heading: DAGDHA YOGA

planetary.freeform: Auspicious works are prohibited when these nakshatras coincide with respective weekdays.

rules.notes: Dagdha yoga formed by specific nakshatras and tithis is inauspicious.

rules.heading: VISHA HUTASHANA YAMA-GHANTA YOGAS

planetary.freeform: These nakshatras combined with specific weekdays create inauspicious yogas.

rules.notes: Visha, Hutashana, and Yama-Ghanta yogas formed by these nakshatras are harmful.

rules.heading: KARKACHA AND SAMVARTAKA YOGA

planetary.freeform: Shashthi (6) on Saturday, Saptami (7) on Friday, Ashtami (8) on Thursday, Navami (9) on Wednesday, Dashmi (10) on Tuesday, Ekadashi (11) on Monday, Dwadashi (12) on Sunday; or Pratipada (1) on Wednesday and Saptami (7) on Sunday.

rules.notes: Certain combinations of tithis and weekdays form inauspicious Karkacha and Samvartaka yogas during which cleaning teeth with a stick is prohibited.

rules.heading: COLLECTION OF WOOD PROHIBITION

planetary.freeform: Prohibited on Pratipada, Amavasya, Shashthi, Navami and Sunday according to Kashi Khanda Granatha.

rules.notes: Collection of wood should not be made on specific tithis and Sundays.

rules.heading: PROHIBITED PERSONAL CARE AND ACTIVITIES

planetary.freeform: Shashthi for oiling, Ashtami for eating flesh, Chaturdashi for shaving, Amavasya for sexual intercourse; Trayodashi, Dashmi, Dwitiya for ubatan; Amavasya, Saptami, Navami for amla bath.

rules.notes: Specific tithis are prohibited for personal grooming activities like oiling, shaving, applying ubatan, and other acts.

rules.heading: DAGDHA YOGA

planetary.freeform: Dwadashi on Sunday, Ekadashi on Monday, Panchami on Tuesday, Tritiya on Wednesday, Shashthi on Thursday, Ashtami on Friday, Navami on Saturday

rules.notes: Dagdha yoga is formed when specific tithis fall on specific weekdays, making the time inauspicious.

rules.heading: VISHA YOGA

planetary.freeform: Chaturthi on Sunday, Shashthi on Monday, Saptami on Tuesday, Dwitiya on Wednesday, Ashtami on Thursday, Navami on Friday, Saptami on Saturday

rules.notes: Visha yoga is formed by specific combinations of tithis and weekdays.

rules.heading: HUTASHANA YOGA

planetary.freeform: Dwadashi on Sunday, Shashthi on Monday, Saptami on Tuesday, Ashtami on Wednesday, Navami on Thursday, Dashmi on Friday, Ekadashi on Saturday

rules.notes: Hutashana yoga is formed when certain tithis coincide with certain weekdays.

rules.heading: YAMA GHANTA YOGA

planetary.freeform: Magha on Sunday, Vishakha on Monday, Ardra on Tuesday, Moola on Wednesday, Krittika on Thursday, Rohini on Friday, Hasta on Saturday

rules.notes: Yamaghanta yoga is formed by the concurrence of specific nakshatras and weekdays.

rules.heading: ZERO TITHIS OF CHAITRADI MASAS OR MONTHS IN BOTH THE PAKSHAS

planetary.freeform: Specific tithis in specific lunar months as zero tithis in both pakshas

rules.notes: Certain tithis in specific lunar months are designated as zero tithis during which no auspicious deeds should be performed.

rules.heading: INAUSPICIOUSNESS ARISING OUT OF THE CONJUNCTION OF TITHI AND NAKSHTRA

planetary.freeform: Conjunction of specific nakshatras falling on specific tithis

rules.notes: Specific combinations of nakshatras falling on particular tithis are considered inauspicious for performing auspicious deeds.

rules.heading: ZERO NAKSHTRAS (STARS) IN THE MONTHS CHAITRA ETC.

planetary.freeform: Certain nakshatras mapped to specific lunar months causing Zero Nakshatra dosha

rules.notes: Performing auspicious deeds during designated Zero Nakshatras for specific months causes loss of wealth.

rules.heading: ZERO SIGNS IN THE MONTHS CHAITRA ETC.

planetary.freeform: Zero signs in Chaitra is Aquarius, Vaishakha is Pisces, Jyeshtha is Taurus, Ashadha is Gemini, Shravana is Aries, Bhadrapada is Virgo, Ashvina is Scorpio, Kartika is Libra, Margashirsha is Sagittarius, Pausha is Cancer, Magha is Capricorn, Phalguna is Leo.

rules.notes: Performing auspicious deeds in these zero signs causes destruction of family and money.

rules.heading: THE ZERO TITHIS AND ZERO SIGNS

planetary.freeform: Pisces on Trayodashi (13), and zero signs (Libra, Leo, Gemini, Sagittarius, Cancer, Taurus, Capricorn, Virgo, Aquarius depending on month/tithi)

rules.notes: Zero tithis and zero signs should be left out for auspicious deeds in Madhya Desha, but are acceptable in other regions.

rules.heading: LEAVING OUT OF PANGU-ANDHA ETC. ASCENDANTS AND ZERO SIGNS

planetary.freeform: Pangu (Lame), Andha-Kana (Blind/One-eyed) Ascendants and zero signs

rules.notes: Pangu, Andha-Kana ascendants and zero signs must be avoided for auspicious deeds only in Gaur and Malawa countries.

rules.heading: COMBINATIONS WHICH ARE TO BE LEFT OUT IN DOING ALL AUSPICIOUS DEEDS

planetary.freeform: Conjunction of specific weekday, tithi, and nakshatra forms Madhu Sarpisha yoga and must be avoided.

exclusions: Panchami tithi with Hasta on Sunday
Saptami tithi with Ashwini on Tuesday
Shashthi tithi with Mrigashira on Monday
Ashtami tithi with Anuradha on Wednesday
Dashmi tithi with Revati on Friday
Navami tithi with Pushya on Thursday
Ekadashi tithi with Rohini on Saturday
rules.notes: These specific triple combinations of weekday, tithi, and nakshatra form the inauspicious Madhu Sarpisha yoga and are forbidden for all auspicious deeds.

rules.heading: YOGAS WHICH ARE TO BE AVOIDED IN ENTERING NEW HOUSE, TRAVELLING AND MARRYING (HALAHALA YOGA)

planetary.freeform: Conjunction of Sunday-Panchami-Krittika, Monday-Dwitiya-Chitra, Tuesday-Poornima-Rohini, Wednesday-Saptami-Bharani, Thursday-Trayodashi-Anuradha, and Saturday-Ashtami-Revati.

rules.notes: Maharishi Vashistha describes this second variety of Madhu Sarpisha yoga known as Halahala yoga.

rules.heading: YOGAS WHICH ARE TO BE AVOIDED IN ENTERING NEW HOUSE, TRAVELLING AND MARRYING

planetary.freeform: Ashwini on Tuesday, Rohini on Saturday, and Pushya on Thursday.

exclusions: Ashwini on Tuesday for entering newly constructed house
rules.notes: Although these form Siddhi yoga normally, they must be rejected specifically for house entry, travel, and marriage.

rules.heading: NAMES OF ANAND ETC YOGAS

planetary.freeform: These 28 are the Chala or movable yogas. Kaladanda, Dhoomra, Dhawanksha, Vajra, Mudgar, Padma, Lumba, Utpaat, Mrityu, Kaana, Musala, Gada, Raksha are inauspicious yogas and the rest are auspicious.

rules.notes: There are 28 Ananda etc. yogas, of which specific ones are classified as inauspicious and the rest as auspicious.

rules.heading: METHOD OF FINDING OUT THE ANANDA ETC. YOGAS

planetary.freeform: Count from Ashwini on Sunday, Mrigashira on Monday, Ashlesha on Tuesday, Hasta on Wednesday, Anuradha on Thursday, Uttarashadha on Friday, and Shatabhisha (including Abhijit) on Saturday to the current nakshatra.

rules.notes: To find the 28 Ananda yogas, start counting from specific base nakshatras depending on the weekday up to the current nakshatra.

rules.heading: WEEKDAY AND NAKSHATRA YOGAS

planetary.freeform: Yoga formed by counting from Mrigashira to the current nakshatra on Monday, or from Anuradha to Vishakha on Thursday

rules.notes: 28 different yogas are formed based on the combination of weekdays and the rising nakshatra.

rules.heading: REJECTION OR LEAVING OUT OF INAUSPICIOUS YOGAS

planetary.freeform: Specific initial ghatis of certain yogas and the entire duration of others are rejected

exclusions: first 5 ghatis of Dhwanksha, Vajra, and Mudgar yogas
first 4 ghatis of Padma and Lumba yogas
full time of Rakshasa, Mrityu, Utpaat, and Kala yogas
rules.notes: Avoid specific initial ghatis of certain malefic yogas, and completely avoid Rakshasa, Mrityu, Utpaat, and Kala yogas for auspicious works.

rules.heading: RAVI YOGA

planetary.freeform: Counting from the Sun's nakshatra to the Moon's nakshatra results in specific numbers such as 4, 9, 10, 13, or 29

rules.notes: Ravi yoga formed by certain distance counts between the Sun and Moon is considered destructive to all auspicious activities.

rules.heading: SARVARTHA SIDDHI YOGA

planetary.freeform: Combination of specific weekdays and corresponding nakshatras

rules.notes: Sarvartha Siddhi yoga is formed when specific nakshatras fall on specific weekdays, granting success in all undertakings.

rules.heading: SPECULUM OF SARVARTHA SIDDHI YOGA

planetary.freeform: Combination of specific weekdays and nakshatras yields Sarvartha Siddhi yoga

rules.notes: Certain combinations of weekdays and nakshatras form Sarvartha Siddhi yoga which is auspicious for all deeds.

rules.heading: UTPAATADI YOGA (UTPAATA, MRITYU, KANA AND SIDDHA YOGA)

planetary.freeform: Starting from specified nakshatras on specific weekdays, groups of four nakshatras sequentially form Utpaata, Mrityu, Kana, and Siddha yogas.

rules.notes: Counting four nakshatras from the designated starting nakshatra for each weekday gives Utpaata, Mrityu, Kana, and Siddha yogas respectively.

rules.heading: THE ORDER OF THE INAUSPICIOUS YOGAS IN VARIOUS COUNTRIES OR REGIONS

planetary.freeform: Yogas formed by conjunction of tithi, day, and nakshatra

rules.notes: Certain inauspicious yogas formed by combinations of tithi, day, and nakshatra should be rejected in the regions of Punjab, Bengal, and Nepal.

rules.heading: THINGS TO BE REJECTED IN DOING ALL THE AUSPICIOUS DEEDS

planetary.freeform: Lagna or Ascendant and Navamsha occupied by the Moon and malefic planets (emaciated Moon, Sun, Mars, Saturn), third part of a Ghati or 20 Palas before and after mid day and mid night, Navamsha of a malefic planet, three days before an eclipse, seven days after a portent, an eclipse, the whole day of an auspicious portent, nakshatras cleaved by planets, nakshatras in planetary war, or nakshatras with an utpaata or portent (rejected for six months)

exclusions: Lagna occupied by Moon and malefics
Navamsha occupied by Moon and malefics
mid day and mid night central ghati period
nakshatras with planetary war, cleavage, or portents
rules.notes: Lists general astrological conditions, times, and celestial afflictions that must be avoided for all auspicious activities.

rules.heading: THE NAKSHTRAS IN WHICH ECLIPSES OCCUR

planetary.freeform: Nakshatra in which an eclipse occurs is rejected (6 months for full eclipse, 3 months for half eclipse, 1 month for one-fourth eclipse). Avoid 3 days before/after or specific rising/setting eclipse conditions.

rules.notes: Nakshatras afflicted by eclipses are forbidden for auspicious deeds for varying durations depending on the extent of the eclipse.

rules.heading: ORGANS OF THE PANCHANGA WHICH ARE TO BE AVOIDED IN DOING AUSPICIOUS DEEDS

planetary.freeform: Birth nakshatra, birth month, birth date, Vyatipata, Bhadra, Vaidhriti yoga, Amavasya, day of death of father and mother, and tithi that has not occurred.

rules.notes: Certain specific sensitive panchang elements like birth star, specific yogas, and dark moon tithi must be avoided for auspicious activities.

rules.heading: REJECTION OF KSHAYA TITHI, VRIDDHI TITHI, KULIKA, ARDHAYAMA, PATA AND DOSHAS IN VISHKAMBHA AND VAJRA YOGAS

planetary.freeform: Reject Kshaya tithi (destroyed tithi), Vriddhi tithi (added tithi), unoccurring month, added month, Kulika, Ardhayama, Pata, and the first 3 ghatis of Vishkambha and Vajra yogas.

rules.notes: Certain days, months, and malefic portions of yogas like Vishkambha and Vajra must be avoided for auspicious activities.

rules.heading: THE GHATIS OF PARIDHA ETC. YOGAS THAT ARE TO BE REJECTED

planetary.freeform: First half of Paridha yoga, first 5 ghatis of Shubha yoga, first 6 ghatis of Ganda yoga, first 6 ghatis of Atiganda yoga, and first 9 ghatis of Vyaghata yoga must be rejected.

rules.notes: Specific initial portions of specific yogas are considered inauspicious and should be avoided.

rules.heading: PAKSHA RANDHRA TITHIS

planetary.freeform: The first 8, 9, 14, 25, 10, and 5 Ghatis respectively of the 4th, 6th, 8th, 9th, 12th, and 14th tithis should be rejected.

rules.notes: Certain specific portions of the 4th, 6th, 8th, 9th, 12th, and 14th tithis in both pakshas are rejected for auspicious deeds.

rules.heading: THE WAY TO FIND OUT KULIKA, KAL-BELA, YAMA-GHANTA AND KANTAKA INAUSPICIOUS MUHURTAS

planetary.freeform: Count from the current day to Saturday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Tuesday respectively, then double the number to find the corresponding inauspicious Muhurta for Kulika, Kalbela, Yama Ghanta, and Kantaka.

rules.notes: Provides a method to calculate the inauspicious Muhurtas of Kulika, Kalbela, Yama Ghanta, and Kantaka based on counting weekdays and doubling the result.

rules.heading: THE TABLE OF KULIKA ETC. YOGAS

planetary.freeform: Performing journey, marriage, or vrata bandha during Kulika, Kal Bela, Yamghanta, or Kantaka leads to negative results such as death, widowhood, or deprivation of Vedic knowledge, though Vashistha states these 4 are not inauspicious at night and Yamaghanlaka's evil effects are specific to regions between Vindhya and Himachala.

rules.notes: Journey, marriage, and vrata bandha are prohibited during the inauspicious daytime muhurtas of Kulika, Kal Bela, Yamghanta, and Kantaka, with exceptions noted for nighttime and certain geographic regions.

rules.heading: EVIL MOMENTS AND MUHURTAS (KALAMSHA AND KULIKA)

planetary.freeform: Kalamsha is the 6th part of Dinmana; Kulika, Kantaka, Kalabela, Ardhayama, and Yamaghanta are evil Muhurtas based on weekday and tithi combinations.

rules.notes: Specific tithis on each weekday constitute evil moments (Kalamsha) and evil Muhurtas (like Kulika) which must be avoided for all auspicious deeds.

rules.heading: REJECTION OF HOLASHATAKA ETC IN MARRIAGE ETC

planetary.freeform: Applicable only in the regions on the shores of Vipasha, Iravati, Shutudra, and Tripushkara during the 8 days before the festival of Holi.

rules.notes: The 8 days before Holi are considered inauspicious for marriage and other auspicious deeds specifically in regions near the Vipasha, Iravati, and Shutudra rivers and Tripushkara.

rules.heading: REJECTION OF CERTAIN YOGAS LIKE MRITYU, KRAKACHA ETC

planetary.freeform: Good effect due to Moon's auspiciousness in various houses (Gochara); some say good after one prahara, others say reject only for journey

rules.notes: Inauspicious yogas like Mrityu and Krakacha can become auspicious due to the Moon's good transit or after one prahara.

rules.heading: OTHER WAYS IN WHICH INAUSPICIOUS YOGAS ARE REMOVED

planetary.freeform: Presence of a strong auspicious yoga or a favourable Lagna destroys inauspicious yogas; Bhadra and inauspicious yogas like Vaidhriti and Vyatipata give good effects after noontime.

rules.notes: Auspicious yogas or a favourable Lagna neutralize inauspicious combinations, and certain negative periods like Bhadra or Vaidhriti yield good results after noon.

rules.heading: DETAILS OF BHADRA

planetary.freeform: Bhadra karana occurs in the first half of 8th and 15th tithis, and in the latter half of 4th and 11th tithis during Shukla Paksha.

rules.notes: Bhadra (Vishti) karana is present during specific halves of certain tithis in Shukla Paksha.

rules.heading: DETAILS OF BHADRA KRISHNA PAKSHA

planetary.freeform: Bhadra karana occurs in the latter half of 3rd and 10th tithis, and in the first half of 7th and 14th tithis during Krishna Paksha.

rules.notes: Bhadra karana is present during specific halves of certain tithis in Krishna Paksha.

rules.heading: THE STHIR KARANAS (FIXED KARANAS)

planetary.freeform: Shakuni occurs in the latter half of the 14th tithi of Krishna Paksha, Naga in the first half of Amavasya, Chatushpada in the second half of Amavasya, and Kinstughana in the first half of Pratipada of Shukla Paksha.

rules.notes: Describes the distribution and occurrence of the four fixed karanas (Shakuni, Naga, Chatushpada, and Kinstughana).

rules.heading: THE MOVABLE KARANAS

planetary.freeform: Bava, Balava, Kaulava, Taitil, Gara, Vanika, and Bhadra (Vishti) rotate cyclically as movable karanas across specific halves of tithis.

rules.notes: Details the sequence and cyclic repetition of the seven movable karanas across various tithi halves.

rules.heading: THE NAMES OF BHADRA KARANA

planetary.freeform: Bhadra Karana names are assigned to the first and second halves of the tithis in order according to Ratna Kosha.

rules.notes: The text lists the eight specific names of Bhadra Karana and their sequential mapping to the halves of various tithis.

rules.heading: DETERMINING THE MOUTH AND TAIL OF BHADRA; AND ITS EFFECTS

planetary.freeform: 5 Ghatis at the beginning of specified Prahara for the mouth of Bhadra

rules.notes: The mouth of Bhadra occurs during specific praharas of Bhadra tithis in both bright and dark halves and is inauspicious.

rules.heading: DETERMINING THE MOUTH AND TAIL OF BHADRA; AND ITS EFFECTS

planetary.freeform: 3 ghatis at the beginning of specified Prahara for the tail of Bhadra, or when Bhadra of the last half is in the day and first half in the night

rules.notes: The tail of Bhadra is auspicious, as well as when the last half of Bhadra is in the day and the first half is in the night.

rules.heading: THE ORDER OF THE MOUTH AND TAIL OF BHADRA

planetary.freeform: Bhadra's mouth occurs in specific praharas depending on the tithi, and its tail occurs in the ending ghatis of the 4th prahara preceding the mouth.

rules.notes: The rule details the calculation and timing of the mouth and tail of Bhadra across different praharas for tithis starting from Chaturthi.

rules.heading: THE LIVING AND EFFECTS OF BHADRA

planetary.freeform: When the Moon is in Aquarius, Pisces, Cancer, or Leo, Bhadra lives in Mrityu Loka; when in Aries, Taurus, Gemini, or Scorpio, in Swargaloka; when in Virgo, Sagittarius, Libra, or Capricorn, in Patal Loka.

rules.notes: The effects of Bhadra are experienced in the specific world (Loka) where she resides based on the Moon's zodiac sign.

rules.heading: THE THINGS WHICH SHOULD NOT BE DONE IN THE COMBUST ETC. STAGES OF JUPITER AND VENUS
activities: building and using of a small well
beginning and ending of a vrata
coming in of a newly wedded wife
learning the first lesson from the guru
first going to a place of pilgrimage

planetary.freeform: When Jupiter and Venus are in old age, in combustion, or in childhood stage, and during Kshaya (intercalary loss) or Mala (additional/leap) month.

rules.notes: Various major sacraments, construction works, and journeys are prohibited during the old age, combustion, or infancy stages of Jupiter and Venus, as well as during Mala or Kshaya months.

rules.heading: THE DEFECTIVE PERIOD WHEN JUPITER IS THERE IN THE SIGN OF LEO OR CAPRICORN, OR WHEN HE IS RETROGRADE OR ATICHARI OR WHEN HE COMBINES WITH THE SUN

planetary.freeform: When Jupiter is in the sign of Leo or Capricorn, or is retrograde, atichari (accelerated motion), or combust/combines with the Sun.

rules.notes: All deeds prohibited during combustion of Jupiter also apply when Jupiter is in Leo, Capricorn, retrograde, atichari, or with the Sun.

rules.heading: PROHIBITIONS DURING JUPITER IN LEO OR CAPRICORN, RETROGRADE, ATICHARI, OR 13-DAY PAKSHA
activities: making things made of ivory or elephant teeth
wearing things made of ivory or elephant teeth
making jewels having gems studded in them
wearing jewels having gems studded in them

planetary.freeform: Jupiter is in Leo or Capricorn, combust, retrograde, atichari, or when Jupiter and the Sun are in the same sign, or when a paksha consists of 13 days (kshaya tithi)

exclusions: Jupiter and Sun in the same sign
rules.notes: Auspicious deeds and crafting or wearing ivory and jeweled items are prohibited during problematic planetary conditions like Jupiter in Leo/Capricorn, combustions, retrogradations, atichaar, Sun-Jupiter conjunction, or a 13-day fortnight.

rules.heading: LEAVING OUT THE PERIOD IN WHICH JUPITER IS IN THE SIGN OF LEO

planetary.freeform: Jupiter is in the sign of Leo and also in the Navamsha of Leo (extending from 4s 13°20' to 4s 16°40'), applicable specifically in regions from the Northern Bank of Godavari to the Southern Bank of the Northern Ganga (Central India, Madhya Bharata, Rajasthan)

exclusions: Regions outside the area between the Northern Bank of Godavari and the Southern Bank of the Northern Ganga
When the Sun is in the sign of Aries (removes the defect of Jupiter in Leo)
rules.notes: Marriage and auspicious deeds are prohibited when Jupiter is in Leo and simultaneously in the Leo Navamsha, specifically within the region between the Godavari and Ganga rivers, unless the Sun is in Aries.

rules.heading: SUN IN ARIES OR JUPITER IN LEO FOR MARRIAGE

planetary.freeform: Sun in Aries or Jupiter in Leo

rules.notes: Marriage when the Sun is in Aries or Jupiter is in Leo grants good conduct, truthfulness, jewels, diamonds, happiness, and fame.

rules.heading: DETERMINATION OF THE DEFECTS ARISING OUT OF JUPITER'S SITUATION IN THE SIGN OF LEO

planetary.freeform: Jupiter in the sign of Leo across specific quarters and regions

rules.notes: Jupiter in Leo is generally rejected for auspicious deeds during the first five quarters (all four of Magha and one of Poorva Phalguni), with regional exceptions.

rules.heading: JUPITER IN LEO AND MAGHA NAKSHATRA

planetary.freeform: Jupiter in the sign of Leo, or in the Navamsha of Leo when the Sun is in Aries. Some say Jupiter in Leo is defective and to be rejected only in the year with Magha nakshatra on Pauranmasi in Magha month.

rules.notes: Jupiter in Leo is generally auspicious under certain conditions, though some restrict it when coinciding with Magha nakshatra on the full moon of Magha.

rules.heading: AVOIDANCE OF THE PERIOD FOR PERFORMING AUSPICIOUS DEEDS WHEN JUPITER IS IN THE SIGN OF CAPRICORN OR WHEN HE IS IN HIS FALL

planetary.freeform: Jupiter in Capricorn or in his fall. Permitted in regions east of Reva, west of Gandaki, north and south of Sonbhadra; avoided in Konkana, Magadha, Gaur, and Sindha regions.

rules.notes: Jupiter in Capricorn (his fall) restricts auspicious deeds in specific regions, but is acceptable in others, and only the lowest 5 degrees may need rejection according to commentary.

rules.heading: THE ILPTA SAMVATSARA AND ITS AVOIDANCE IN PERFORMING AUSPICIOUS DEEDS

planetary.freeform: If Jupiter is Atichara

rules.notes: Auspicious deeds should be avoided when Jupiter is in Atichara (accelerated motion), though the text cuts off.

rules.heading: LUPTA-SAMWATSAR AND ATICHAAR OF JUPITER

planetary.freeform: Jupiter becoming Atichari (accelerated motion skipping a sign) and not returning to the former sign via retrogression, except when occurring in Taurus, Aries, Pisces, and Aquarius.

rules.notes: Lupta-samvatsar caused by Jupiter's atichaar is rejected for auspicious deeds, except when it occurs in Taurus, Aries, Pisces, or Aquarius.

rules.heading: VILUPTABD OR LUPTA-SAMVATSAR

planetary.freeform: If Jupiter becomes retrograde and comes back to the former sign from which he became Atichaari, there is no Viluptabd, unless the total time of direct and retrograde movement equals one year.

rules.notes: Rules for determining when a year is considered Lupta-Samvatsar or Viluptabd based on Jupiter's motion.

rules.heading: VAAR PRAVARTI (THE TIME AT WHICH A DAY BEGINS)

planetary.freeform: Calculated using the distance in yojanas of one's city from the Prime meridian line, adjusted by 15 ghatis and the Dinaardha.

rules.notes: Method to calculate the exact moment a weekday begins for a specific location relative to the Prime Meridian.

rules.heading: THE METHOD OF KNOWING THE KAALHORESH

planetary.freeform: The ghatis and palas of the Ishta Kaala from Vaar Pravriti are doubled, divided by 5, remainder subtracted, 1 added, and divided by 7 to find the lord of the Kaal Hora.

rules.notes: This rule outlines the mathematical algorithm to determine the planetary lord of any given Kaal Hora.

rules.heading: SIGNIFICANCE OF THE KAALHORA

planetary.freeform: Deeds prescribed for a particular day or nakshatra may be performed during the Kaal Hora of the lord of that day or the 15th part (Muhurta/Tithyamsha) of that nakshatra, subject to avoiding Vaar Shoola, Nakshatra Shoola, and Parighdanda.

rules.heading: EFFECTS OF THE AHUTI IN THE MOUTH OF PLANETS IN HAVANA

rules.notes: Describes the auspicious and inauspicious results depending on which planet receives the Ahuti during a Havana or Yajna.

rules.heading: THE ABODE OF LIVING OF FIRE IN THE HAVANA AND THE AUSPICIOUS AND INAUSPICIOUS EFFECTS OF IT

planetary.freeform: (Tithi + 1 + weekday number) divided by 4. Remainder 3 or 0: Fire is on Earth (auspicious/happiness); Remainder 1: Fire is in Heaven (loss of life); Remainder 2: Fire is in Paatal/Underworld (loss of wealth).

rules.notes: Calculates the elemental placement of fire for a Havana based on the desired tithi and weekday, determining happiness, loss of life, or loss of wealth.

rules.heading: AGNIVASA CALCULATION

planetary.freeform: Add 1 to the sum of the tithi and the weekday (counted from Sunday = 1), divide by 4. Remainder 1 = Heaven, Remainder 2 = Hades/Underworld, Remainder 3 or 0 = Earth (auspicious for Havana).

rules.notes: Rules for calculating the abode of fire (Agnivasa) to determine suitability for conducting fire rituals like Havana.

planetary.freeform: Ascendant in Upachaya houses (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) from natal ascendant and Janma Rashi, no planets in 8th and 12th houses, benefic planets conjunct or aspecting the ascendant, and Moon in Upachaya signs (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) from the ascendant.

rules.notes: Lagna Shuddhi for ordinary auspicious deeds requires the ascendant and Moon to be in Upachaya houses from natal ascendant and Janma Rashi, empty 8th and 12th houses, and benefic influences on the ascendant.

rules.heading: FEVER CONTRACTED NAKSHATRAS
rules.notes: Fever contracted in these specific nakshatras leads to death.

rules.heading: FEVER DURATION NAKSHATRAS

rules.notes: A snake bite in these nakshatras leads to death unless the Moon is strong.

rules.heading: THE COMBINATION WHICH LEADS TO IMMEDIATE DEATH AT THE BEGINNING OF THE DISEASE
rules.notes: Disease beginning under this combination of nakshatra, weekday, and tithi leads to quick death.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR PRET KRIYA AND THE DEEDS WHICH SHOULD NOT BE DONE DURING PANCHAKA

planetary.freeform: Moon in Aquarius and Pisces, from 3rd quarter of Dhanishtha to Revati (Panchaka)

rules.notes: Pret kriya is favorable in specific nakshatras, but cremation and similar deeds should be avoided during Panchaka.

rules.heading: PROHIBITED DEEDS IN PANCHAKA NAKSHTRAS

planetary.freeform: During Panchaka nakshatras

rules.notes: Certain actions like cremation, southern journeys, bed weaving, and thatching are prohibited during Panchaka nakshatras unless pacification rites are performed.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE COLLECTION OF WOOD ETC.

planetary.freeform: Nakshatra groups counted relative to Sun and Moon positions

rules.notes: The results of collecting wood vary depending on which nakshatra group (Adhaha Sthala, Shirsha, Madhya, Poorva, Dakshina, Pashchima, or Uttara) the collection is made in.

rules.heading: THE YOGAS OF TRIPUSHKARA AND DWIPUSHKARA

planetary.freeform: Conjunction of Saturday, Tuesday, Sunday, specific nakshatras, and Bhadra tithis

rules.notes: Tripushkara yoga multiplies the effect of death, destruction, or profit by threefold.

rules.heading: THE YOGAS OF TRIPUSHKARA AND DWIPUSHKARA

planetary.freeform: Conjunction of Saturday, Tuesday, Sunday, Dhanishtha, Chitra, Mrigashira, and Bhadra tithis

rules.notes: Dwipushkara yoga multiplies the effect of any event by twofold.

rules.heading: THE TIME WHICH SHOULD BE REJECTED IN DOING 'PUTTALA DAHA' OR THE BURNING (CREMATION) OF A DUMMY OF SOMEONE

planetary.freeform: Rejected on specific days, tithis, 11 nakshatras, and Tripushkara yoga

rules.notes: Puttala daha should be avoided on specified inauspicious days, tithis, nakshatras, and yoga.

rules.heading: THE AUSPICIOUS AND INAUSPICIOUS TIME FOR THE PERSON WHO BURNS THE DUMMY

planetary.freeform: Avoid Janama and Pratyaari Tara, and when the moon is in 4th, 8th, or 12th house from Janama Rashi.

exclusions: Moon in 4th, 8th, or 12th from Janama Rashi
rules.notes: Pret kriya or dummy cremation yields medium effects when performed in specific nakshatras while avoiding unfavorable transit tara and moon positions.

rules.heading: THE PRET KRIYA

planetary.freeform: Not to be done during the time of Ashaucha (period of Pataka); avoid Janama Nakshatra and Pratyari Nakshatras (5th, 10th, 14th, 19th, and 23rd from Janama Nakshatra); avoid Moon in 4th, 8th, or 12th houses.

rules.notes: Pret Kriya and related cremation rites are auspicious on specific days and nakshatras, but forbidden during Ashaucha, birth nakshatra, specific distance nakshatras, and malefic moon positions.

rules.heading: THE CONSIDERATION OF ABHUKTA MOOLA

planetary.freeform: Defined variously by sages: Narada says last 4 ghatis of Jyeshtha and first 4 ghatis of Moola (8 ghatis); Vashishtha says last 1 ghati of Jyeshtha and first 2 ghatis of Moola (3 ghatis); Brahaspati says last half ghati of Jyeshtha and first half ghati of Moola.

rules.notes: Abhukta Moola defines specific sensitive junction periods between Jyeshtha and Moola nakshatras considered inauspicious.

rules.heading: THE MEASURE OF AND THE EFFECTS OF ABHUKTAMOOLA ACCORDING TO ANOTHER OPINION

planetary.freeform: first eight ghatis of Moola and last 5 ghatis of Jyeshtha

rules.notes: Birth in Abhuktamoola (first 8 ghatis of Moola and last 5 ghatis of Jyeshtha) is highly inauspicious, requiring the child to be given up or the father not to see its face for eight years.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE BIRTH IN THE NAKSHTRA OF MOOLA AS PER DIFFERENCE OF QUARTER AND IN THAT OF ASHLESHA

planetary.freeform: 1st quarter causes father's death, 2nd quarter causes mother's death, 3rd quarter causes loss of wealth, 4th quarter is auspicious

rules.notes: Quarter-wise effects for Moola nakshatra birth indicate severe parental or financial harm unless pacification is performed.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE BIRTH IN THE NAKSHTRA OF MOOLA AS PER DIFFERENCE OF QUARTER AND IN THAT OF ASHLESHA

planetary.freeform: 1st quarter is auspicious, 2nd quarter causes loss of wealth, 3rd quarter causes mother's death, 4th quarter causes father's death

rules.notes: Quarter-wise effects for Ashlesha nakshatra birth reverse the malefic pattern seen in Moola.

rules.heading: THE ABODE OF THE NAKSHTRA OF MOOLA

planetary.freeform: Inauspicious effects occur depending on the realm where Moola resides in specific months (Heaven in Ashadha, Bhadrapada, Ashwin, Magha; Earth in Shravana, Kartika, Chaitra, Pausha; Underworld in Phalguna, Margashirsha, Vaishakha, Jyeshtha).

rules.notes: The asterism Moola brings inauspicious effects depending on whether it resides in Heaven, Earth, or the Underworld during specific months.

rules.heading: THE INAUSPICIOUS TIME FOR THE BIRTH OF A CHILD

planetary.freeform: Child birth occurring in Gandanta (Tithi, Nakshatra, Lagna), Tithi Kshaya, on a Sankranti, on Sinivali or Kuhu Amavasya, during Bhadra karana, or in the Janma Nakshatra of brother, sister, mother, or father is inauspicious and requires pacification (Shanti).

rules.notes: Birth during specified malefic yogas, ganda points, dark lunar nodes, and family birth-stars is inauspicious and requires Shanti rituals.

rules.heading: THE NUMBER OF THE TARAS (OR STARS) OF THE NAKSHATRAS ASHWINI ETC.

planetary.freeform: Describes the number of stars (Taras) in each of the 27 nakshatras.

rules.notes: Lists the astronomical count of stars composing each nakshatra.

rules.heading: THE SHAPES OF THE NAKSHATRAS

planetary.freeform: Describes the symbolic shape or form associated with each nakshatra.

rules.notes: Details the traditional shapes of the asterisms used for identification and astrological symbolism.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR DIGGING AND BUILDING A TANK, FOR PLANTING A GARDEN OR AN ORCHARD AND ESTABLISHING AN IMAGE OF SOME GOD OR GODDESS
activities: establishing an image of some god or goddess

planetary.freeform: in the Uttarayana of the Sun (January 14 to July 16, except in the month of Chaitra), at the rising of Venus

rules.notes: Auspicious activities like digging tanks, planting gardens, or consecrating idols are best performed during the Sun's northern course, bright fortnight, and specific soft, swift, movable, or fixed nakshatras when Venus is visible.

rules.heading: ESTABLISHING OF IMAGES AND PLANETS

establishing images of all the gods

establishing images of the gods of jains

rules.notes: Rules specify planetary positions, ascendant types, nakshatras, and excluded tithis and days for the installation of various deities and planets.

rules.heading: AUSPICIOUS TIME FOR THE FIRST APPEARANCE OF THE MENSES

planetary.freeform: in the 7 months of Magha, Margashirsha, Baisakha, Ashwina, Phalguna, Jyeshtha and Shravana; in an auspicious Ascendant and in the day time

rules.notes: First appearance of menses is auspicious during Shukla paksha in specific months, auspicious weekdays, daytime, and auspicious Ascendant.

rules.heading: EXCELLENT, MEDIUM AND LOW NAKSHTRAS FOR THE FIRST APPEARANCE OF WOMEN'S MENSES

planetary.freeform: wearing white clean clothes

rules.notes: Lists excellent nakshatras for the first appearance of menses.

rules.heading: THE TIME WHICH SHOULD BE REJECTED IN THE FIRST APPEARANCE OF WOMEN'S MENSES

planetary.freeform: during sleep, on the day of a Sankranti, in the evening time, in the diseased condition, during the period of the eclipses of the Sun and the Moon

rules.notes: The first appearance of women's menses is considered inauspicious during Bhadra and Rikta tithis, Amavasya, specific tithis like 6, 8, 12, certain yogas, eclipses, and other restricted times.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE BATHING OF WOMEN AFTER MENSES
rules.notes: Bathing after menses is recommended on specific auspicious nakshatras, tithis, and weekdays to promote conception and well-being.

rules.heading: THE TIME WHICH IS TO BE REJECTED IN HAVING SEXUAL INTERCOURSE FOR CONCEPTION

planetary.freeform: Leave the three gandantas (Tithi, Nakshatra, Lagna), Vadha and Janama Tara (7/10/16/19/25th Nakshatras), time of solar and lunar eclipse, days of shraddha of father and mother, daytime, first half of Parigha yoga, nakshatra troubled by utpaata, lagna of 8th rashi from janama rashi, and malefic lagna

rules.notes: Various times, nakshatras, yogas, and lagnas to be avoided for conception.

rules.heading: FURTHER THINGS WHICH SHOULD BE KNOWN ABOUT THE MUHURTA OF CONCEPTION

planetary.freeform: Bhadra karana, Shashthi tithi, days of festivals, Rikta tithis, evening time, Tuesday, Sunday, Saturday, and the first 4 nights from the beginning of menstrual discharge should be left

rules.notes: Certain karanas, tithis, weekdays, and times must be avoided for conception.

rules.heading: FURTHER THINGS WHICH SHOULD BE KNOWN ABOUT THE MUHURTA OF CONCEPTION (AUSPICIOUS NAKSHATRAS)
rules.notes: Sexual intercourse for conception is auspicious in the three Uttara nakshatras.

rules.heading: NAKSHATRAS FOR CONCEPTION (SON)
rules.notes: Certain nakshatras and weekdays like Sunday and Tuesday are auspicious for conceiving a son.

rules.heading: FAVOURABLE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT FOR CONCEPTION

planetary.freeform: Benefic Planets in the Angles (1/4/7/10) and Trines (5/9); Malefic Planets in 3/6/11 Houses; aspect of male planets (Sun, Mars, Jupiter) on the Ascendant; Moon and Ascendant in the Navamsha of an odd sign

rules.notes: Specific planetary placements in houses, aspect of male planets, and odd navamshas favor the conception of a son on even nights after menses.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR SIMANTA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Masapati (lord of the month of conception) endowed with strength; 6th or 8th month from conception; Benefic Planets in Angles and Trines; Malefic Planets in 3/6/11 Houses; Ascendant and Navamsha of a Male sign.

rules.notes: Simanta samskara is auspicious on specified weekdays, nakshatras, and tithis when planetary and temporal conditions are favorable.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR SIMANTA SAMSKARA (DHRUWA AND REVATI)

planetary.freeform: Ascendant and Navamsha of a male sign on auspicious days.

rules.notes: Simanta samskara is excellent in Dhruwa nakshatras and Revati on auspicious days with a male sign ascendant and navamsha.

rules.heading: SIMANTONNAYANA SAMSKARA TIMING

planetary.freeform: performed in the 4th or the 6th or the 8th month after conception

rules.notes: Simantonnayana samskara should be performed in the 4th, 6th, or 8th month after conception.

rules.heading: THE LORDS OF THE 10 MONTHS OF CONCEPTION AND THE DETERMINION OF THE STRENGTH OF THE MOON

planetary.freeform: The Lord of the first month of conception is Venus; of the 2nd, Mars; of the 3rd, Jupiter; of the 4th, the Sun; of the 5th, the Moon; of the 6th, Saturn; of the 7th, Mercury; of the 8th, the Ascendant Lord; of the 9th, the Moon; and of the 10th, the Sun. For marriage and conception, the Chandra Bala of the woman is considered; for other samskaras, that of the husband.

rules.notes: Details the ruling planets for each of the 10 months of gestation and specifies whose Chandra Bala (Moon strength) to consult for different samskaras.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE PUNSAVANA SAMSKARA AND VISHNU POOJA

planetary.freeform: In the 8th month, in auspicious Laganas or Ascendants or when there is a benefic planet in auspicious Ascendants, and when the 8th House from the Natal Ascendant is auspicious and is without any Malefic Planet

exclusions: malefic planets in the 8th house from the natal ascendant
rules.notes: Punsavana samskara is performed in the 3rd month on tithis, days, and nakshatras auspicious for Simanta samskara, while Vishnu worship for protection of conception is done in the 8th month under specific favorable astral and planetary conditions.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE JAATAKARMA AND THE NAAMA KARANA SAMSKARAS

planetary.freeform: On the 11th or 12th day from the birth, on an auspicious day

rules.notes: Jaata Karma and Naama Karana samskaras for a newborn should be performed on the 11th or 12th day excluding Parva and Rikta tithis, using Mridu, Dhruwa, Kshipra, or Chara nakshatras.

rules.heading: NAAMAKARANA SAMSKARA TIMING

planetary.freeform: Done in the forenoon is very auspicious, and medium in auspiciousness if done at noon.

rules.notes: Naamakarana is best performed in the forenoon, moderately auspicious at noon, and prohibited in the afternoon and night.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE BATHING OF THE PRASUTI WOMAN - AUSPICIOUS TIER

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE BATHING OF THE PRASUTI WOMAN - INAUSPICIOUS TIER

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE BATHING OF THE PRASUTI WOMAN - MEDIUM TIER
rules.notes: Bathing of the newly delivered woman has medium auspiciousness in the remaining nakshatras and weekdays.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE TEETHING OF A CHILD

planetary.freeform: Teething occurs in the 1st through 10th month after birth, or birth with teeth

rules.notes: The month in which a child gets its first teeth dictates distinct familial and personal outcomes.

exclusions: nakshatras 6 through 20 from the Sun's nakshatra which bring death, weakness, and disease
rules.notes: The text divides the 27 nakshatras starting from the Sun's position into groups yielding different health outcomes for the child's first cradling.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE DOLAROHAN AND TAKING THE CHILD OUT OF THE HOUSE
activities: swinging the child in a cradle
taking the child out of the house

planetary.freeform: On specified lunar days (32nd, 12th, 16th, 18th, and 10th from birth) or in the 4th month from birth, or on the 12th day.

rules.notes: Dolarohan is auspicious on specific days from birth using Mridu, Laghu, and Dhruwa nakshatras during benefic weekdays.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE JALA POOJANA OF THE PRASUTI WOMAN

planetary.freeform: Venus and Jupiter must not be combust; avoid Chaitra, Mala Maasa, and Pausha.

rules.notes: Jala Poojana for a new mother is performed on specific weekdays and nakshatras, avoiding combust planets and certain months.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR ANNA PRASHANA

planetary.freeform: Even months (6, 8, 10, 12) for male children; odd months (5, 7, 9, 11) for female children.

exclusions: Navamsha of the 8th sign from Janama Rashi and Janama Lagna
rules.notes: Anna Prashana is auspicious in specified months, nakshatras, and categories (Mridu, Laghu, Chara, Sthira) while avoiding specific tithis, days, and lagnas.

rules.heading: THE SAMSKARAS (ANNA PRASHANA)

planetary.freeform: Forenoon is recommended; birth nakshatra is also good.

rules.notes: Anna Prashana should be done in the Shukla Paksha during the forenoon, and birth nakshatra is favorable.

rules.heading: LAGNA SHUDDHI OR FAVOURABLE ASCENDANT IN ANNA PRASHANA

planetary.freeform: Benefics in 1, 4, 7, 5, 9, 3 houses; no planet in the 10th house; malefic planets in 3, 6, 11 houses; Ascendant, 8th, and 6th houses without the Moon.

rules.notes: Specifies favorable house placements for benefics and malefics, and lists certain nakshatras as inauspicious according to some teachers.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE PLACES OF THE PLANETS IN ANNA PRASHANA

planetary.freeform: Emaciated Moon or Full Moon or Jupiter or Mercury or Mars or Sun or Saturn in houses 9, 5, 12, 1, 4, 7 from natal ascendant.

rules.notes: Details the specific life or health results of having various planets placed in the 9th, 5th, 12th, 1st, 4th, or 7th houses during Anna Prashana.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE SEATING OF THE CHILD ON THE GROUND
activities: seating the child on the ground

planetary.freeform: 5th month, when Mars is strong, in a Chara or Movable Lagna or Ascendant

rules.notes: The ceremony of seating the child on the ground for the first time should be performed in the 5th month under specific fixed, moveable, or light nakshatras, avoiding Rikta tithis, with Mars strong.

rules.heading: THE DETERMINATION OF THE MEANS OF LIVING OF THE CHILD
activities: determining means of living of the child

planetary.freeform: During the ground-seating ceremony, place various objects like clothes, weapons, books, pens, gold, and silver before the child to determine future livelihood by what the child picks.

rules.notes: The child's future livelihood is predicted based on the first object it touches voluntarily when placed before them during the ground-seating ceremony.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR EATING TAAMBOOL OR BETEL LEAF

planetary.freeform: Benefic planets in angles (1, 4, 7, 10) and trines (1, 5, 9); malefic planets in 3rd, 6th, and 11th houses; ascendants of Gemini, Capricorn, Virgo, Aquarius, Taurus, and Pisces.

rules.notes: Betel leaf eating for children should be done on permitted weekdays and nakshatras with benefics in angles/trines and malefics in 3/6/11.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR KARNA VEDHA OR MAKING HOLE IN THE EARS FOR WEARNING JEWELS

planetary.freeform: Odd years from birth, 6th/7th/8th month or 12th/16th day from birth.

exclusions: sleeping time of Lord Vishnu (Ashadha Shukla Ekadashi to Kartika Shukla Ekadashi)
Janama Tara (1st, 10th, 11th nakshatras from birth nakshatra)
rules.notes: Karna Vedha is excellent on specified days, months, and odd years while avoiding malefic periods like Chaturmas and Rikta tithis.

rules.heading: LAGNA SHUDDHI OR A FAVOURABLE ASCENDANT IN KARNA VEDHA

planetary.freeform: 8th house from natal ascendant without any planet; benefics in angles, trines, and 3/11 houses; ascendant of Venus or Jupiter (Taurus, Libra, Sagittarius, Pisces); malefics in 3/6/11 houses from natal ascendant; Jupiter in the ascendant.

rules.notes: Karna Vedha samskara is auspicious under specific planetary placements involving benefics, malefics, and Jupiter relative to the natal ascendant.

rules.heading: THE TIME WHICH SHOULD BE REJECTED IN DOING AUSPICIOUS DEEDS
activities: establish the image of a god
entry in a newly built house

planetary.freeform: Dakshinayana of the Sun, childhood or old age of planets, combust condition of Jupiter and Venus, and at the time of the rising of Ketu.

exclusions: childhood or old age of planets
rules.notes: Major auspicious ceremonies and deeds should be avoided during the sun's southern course, planetary combustion, and Ketu's heliacal rise.

rules.heading: THE RISING OF KETU

planetary.freeform: Ketu is rising and visible

rules.notes: Auspicious deeds should not be performed while Ketu is rising and visible.

rules.heading: THE CHILDHOOD AND OLD AGE OF JUPITER AND VENUS

planetary.freeform: Venus has childhood for 3 days after rising in east, 10 days after rising in west; old age 15 days before setting in east, 5 days before setting in west. Jupiter has childhood for 15 days after rising in east and west; old age for 15 days before setting in east and west.

rules.notes: Defines the childhood and old age periods of Jupiter and Venus relative to their rising and setting.

rules.heading: DIFFERENCE OF OPINION WITH REGARD TO THE CHILDHOOD AND THE OLD AGE (OF JUPITER AND VENUS)

planetary.freeform: Jupiter and Venus have childhood and old age for 10 days, 7 days, or 3 days depending on regional customs around rising and setting. The Moon is a child for half a day after rising and old for 3 days before setting.

rules.notes: Regional customs determine the combustion or bala/vriddhi states (childhood and old age) duration for Jupiter, Venus, and the Moon before setting and after rising.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR MUNDANA OR CHUDAKARANA

planetary.freeform: Malefic planets in 3rd, 6th, and 11th houses; 8th house from natal ascendant without any planet (though Venus is allowed)

exclusions: 8th sign from Janama Rashi and Janama Lagna
rules.notes: Mundana ceremony is prescribed on odd years, specific tithis, months in Uttarayana excluding Chaitra, auspicious weekdays, and particular nakshatras with benefics and malefics in favorable positions.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE PLANETS POSITED IN THE ANGLES IN THE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT AT THE TIME OF MUNDANA

planetary.freeform: Emaciated Moon, Mars, Saturn, or Sun in an angle (Kendras) from the Lagna

rules.notes: Placement of the weak Moon, Mars, Saturn, or Sun in angular houses during Mundana causes severe harms like death, wounds, lameness, or fever, while Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus in angles are auspicious.

rules.heading: THE DETERMINATION OF MINDAN A ON THE MOTHER'S BEING PREGNANT

planetary.freeform: If the conception of the mother is of more than 5 months duration, Mundana is prohibited; if the child is more than 5 years of age, Mundana is auspicious even if the mother is pregnant.

exclusions: mother's conception of more than 5 months duration
rules.notes: Mundana is prohibited if the mother's pregnancy exceeds 5 months, unless the child is older than 5 years.

rules.heading: EXCEPTION OF MALEFIC TARA IN DOING MUNDANA

planetary.freeform: Moon is in a Trine, in her own exaltation sign, in the Varga of friendly planets, in her own divisional chart, or in the sign of a Benefic Planet.

rules.notes: Malefic Taras (1/3/5/7th) become auspicious for mundana and travelling if the Moon is strongly placed in trines, own sign, friendly varga, or benefic sign.

rules.heading: THE TIME WHICH IS TO BE REJECTED IN THE MUNDANA OF THE ELDER SON

planetary.freeform: Month of Jyestha for eldest son's mundana; also month of Margashirsha according to some acharyas. Mother having menses or being Prasutika.

rules.notes: Mundana should not be performed when the mother is menstruating or recently delivered, and the eldest son's mundana is prohibited in Jyestha (and Margashirsha).

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR KSHORA-KARMA

planetary.freeform: Proper and auspicious tithis, days and nakshatras stated for Mundana muhurta

rules.notes: Kshora-karma, nail cutting, and teeth cleaning are auspicious on proper Mundana days but forbidden on certain days, times, tithis, and specific personal conditions.

rules.heading: RESTRICTIONS FOR A MAN WHOSE WIFE IS PREGNANT
activities: travelling to a place of pilgrimage

planetary.freeform: Man whose wife is pregnant

rules.notes: A man with a pregnant wife must avoid carrying corpses, pilgrimages, foreign travel, sea bathing, and shaving.

rules.heading: PROHIBITED NAKSHATRAS FOR REPEATED KSHORA-KARMA

planetary.freeform: Repeated shaving within a year in specific counts

rules.notes: Repeated shaving in Krittika, Anuradha, Rohini, Magha, and Uttara Phalguni leads to adverse results.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE BEGINNING OF LEARNING LETTERS BY CHILDREN
activities: beginning of learning letters by children

planetary.freeform: In the 5th year from birth after worshipping deities

rules.notes: A child should begin learning letters in the 5th year after worshipping Ganesha, Vishnu, Saraswati, and Lakshmi.

rules.heading: THE SAMSKARAS LETTERS
activities: beginning of learning the letters of the alphabet

planetary.freeform: benefic Lagnas (2/3/6/9/12) except Chara Rashis (movable signs); no planet in the 8th House from the Ascendant

rules.notes: Auspicious constellations, tithis, and non-movable lagnas are prescribed for beginning the learning of letters, avoiding the 6th tithi and planets in the 8th house.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE BEGINNING OF GETTING EDUCATION

planetary.freeform: Lord of the Ascendant running should be a benefic planet; benefic planets in the Angles and Trines from the Ascendant

rules.notes: Specific nakshatras, weekdays, and tithis are favorable for beginning education, along with benefic placements for the lagna lord and planets in kendras and trines.

rules.heading: THE TIME OF UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Brahmins in 8th or 5th year from conception/birth, Kshatriyas in 6th or 11th year, Vaishyas in 8th or 12th year (ideal time); twice the prescribed time is medium level

rules.notes: Specifies the ideal and medium years of age from conception or birth for the Upanayana samskara based on varna.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Sun in Pisces; first third part of the day (Poorvanha) is main period; first 3rd part (up to 5th Tithi) of Krishna Paksha is also acceptable

exclusions: Madhyanha (unless lack of auspicious ascendant in Poorvanha)
Punarvasu for Brahmins (according to some views)
rules.notes: Upanayana is prescribed during specific nakshatras, weekdays, and tithis in Shukla paksha or early Krishna paksha, preferably in the morning.

rules.heading: THE AUSPICIOUS LAGNA OR ASCENDANT FOR THE UPANAYANA MUHURTA

planetary.freeform: Venus, Jupiter, the Moon and the Ascendant Lord are in the 6th and 8th House; Malefic Planets are in the 1st, 8th, and 5th Houses.

exclusions: Venus, Jupiter, Moon, and Ascendant Lord in 6th/8th houses
rules.notes: Venus, Jupiter, Moon, and Ascendant lord should not be in the 6th or 8th house, and malefics in the 1st, 8th, or 5th are inauspicious for upanayana.

rules.heading: THE FAVOURABLE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT IN THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Benefics should not be in 6/8/12 houses. Malefics in 3/6/11 houses are auspicious. Full Moon in exaltation or own sign in ascendant is excellent.

rules.notes: Benefics are forbidden in 6/8/12, malefics are auspicious in 3/6/11, and the Full Moon is excellent if in exaltation or own sign in the ascendant.

rules.heading: THE LORDS OF THE VARNAS LIKE BRAHMINS ETC AND OF THE VEDAS

planetary.freeform: Lists planetary lords for varnas (Brahmins: Jupiter, Venus; Kshatriyas: Sun, Mars; Vaishyas: Moon; Shudras: Mercury; Antyajas: Saturn) and Vedas (Rigaveda: Jupiter, Yajurveda: Venus, Saamaveda: Mars, Atharvaveda: Mercury).

rules.notes: Provides the planetary rulers for different social classes (varnas) and Vedas.

rules.heading: THE AUSPISIOUSNESS OR THE INAUSPICIOUSNESS OF THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Strong position of the planets who are the Lords of the Vedas, Sun, Moon, and Jupiter. For Rigveda: Thursday, 9/12 Lagnas, strength of Jupiter; for Yajurveda: Friday, 2/7 Lagnas, strength of Venus; for Samaveda: Tuesday, 1/8 Lagnas; for Atharvaveda: Wednesday, 3/6 Lagnas, strength of Mercury.

exclusions: Jupiter and Venus in enemy's sign
Jupiter and Venus in deep debilitation sign
Jupiter and Venus defeated in planetary war
rules.notes: Planetary strengths and specific weekdays/lagnas according to the Vedas are auspicious for the Upanayana ceremony, while debilitated or defeated lords are harmful.

rules.heading: EXCEPION OF THE MONTH OF THE BIRTH ETC. IN THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Performing Upanayana on the birth nakshatra, month, lagna, and tithi is beneficial for the eldest child of Brahmin varna, or for Kshetriya/Vaishya children born after the first conception.

rules.notes: Using birth-time factors (nakshatra, month, lagna, tithi) is exceptionally auspicious for Upanayana under specific birth-order and varna conditions.

rules.heading: JUPITER TRANSIT PLACEMENT IN MARRIAGE AND UPANAYANA

planetary.freeform: Jupiter in 2nd, 5th, 7th, 9th, or 11th houses from Janma Rashi is excellent. Jupiter in 1st, 3rd, 6th, or 10th houses requires pacification/worship. Jupiter in 4th, 8th, or 12th houses is inauspicious.

exclusions: Jupiter in 4th, 8th, or 12th houses from Janma Rashi
rules.notes: Jupiter's transit placement from the natal moon determines its favorability for marriage and upanayana.

rules.heading: THE EXCEPTION OF THE INAUSPICIOUS JUPITER

planetary.freeform: Jupiter in exaltation, own sign, or friend's sign, while being in its own Navamsha, Vargottama Navamsha, or exalted Navamsha, becomes auspicious even in the 4th, 8th, or 12th houses.

exclusions: Jupiter in debilitation or enemy's sign
rules.notes: Strong navamsha placement can override unfavorable house transits for Jupiter.

rules.heading: THE TIME WHICH SHOULD BE REJECTED IN THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Krishna paksha from 6th tithi to Amavasya, Pradosha days, Anadhyaya days, Saturdays, afternoon (Apranha Kaala) on days with morning thunder and lightning, and Galagraha tithis (13, 14, 15, 30, 1, 4, 7, 8, 9).

rules.notes: Upanayana is prohibited during specific dark fortnight tithis, Saturdays, and troubled weather or astrological conditions.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE NAVAMSHA OF THE PLANETS THE SUN ETC IN THE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT OF UPANAYANA

planetary.freeform: Sun navamsha in lagna: cruel-minded; Moon navamsha: stupid; Mars navamsha: sinner; Mercury navamsha: clever; Jupiter navamsha: doer of shatakarma; Venus navamsha: doer of yagya and wealthy; Saturn navamsha: stupid.

rules.notes: Describes the personality or future traits of the child based on the planetary navamsha rising in the upanayana lagna.

rules.heading: THE SPECIALITY ABOUT THE NAVAMSHA OF THE MOON

planetary.freeform: Moon in auspicious navamsha: gets education; malefic navamsha: penurious; own navamsha: unhappy, but if in Shravana or Punarvasu and in own navamsha: wealthy.

rules.notes: Details the results of the Moon occupying various navamshas during the upanayana ceremony.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE PLANETS THE SUN ETC. WHEN THEY ARE POSITED IN THE ANGLES

planetary.freeform: Sun in angle: government service; Moon in angle: merchant; Mars in angle: arms trader or army job; Mercury in angle: teacher; Jupiter in angle: scholar; Venus in angle: wealthy; Saturn in angle: servant to low born.

rules.notes: Explains the vocational and life outcomes when specific planets are placed in angles during upanayana.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF JUPITER, VENUS AND THE MOON WHEN THEY ARE IN CONJUNCTION WITH OTHER PLANETS

planetary.freeform: Jupiter, Venus, or Moon in conjunction with Sun makes the child bereft of good qualities; with Mars makes the child violent; with Saturn makes the child cruel; with Mercury makes the child an intelligent scholar.

rules.notes: Conjunctions of Jupiter, Venus, or Moon with specific planets during Upanayana determine the child's character traits.

rules.heading: THE AUSPICIOUS AND INAUSPICIOUS EFFECTS OF THE NAVAMSHA OF THE MOON

planetary.freeform: Moon in Navamsha of Venus, Venus in a trine from Lagna, and Jupiter in Lagna gives knowledge of the Vedas; Moon in Navamsha of Saturn, Jupiter in Lagna, and Venus in a trine makes the child cruel and uncivilized.

rules.notes: The Navamsha placement of the Moon along with Venus and Jupiter dictates whether the child becomes learned or cruel.

rules.heading: ANADHYAYA

planetary.freeform: Day of Sankranti

exclusions: 10th tithi of Shukla Paksha of Ashadha
2nd tithi of Shukla Paksha of Jyeshtha
11th tithi of Shukla Paksha of Pausha
12th tithi of Shukla Paksha of Magha
1st, 8th, 14th, 15th, and 30th tithis of both Shukla and Krishna pakshas
rules.notes: Certain tithis and days are classified as Anadhyaya and must be rejected for performing Upanayana Samskara.

rules.heading: THE CHARACTERISTICS OF 'PRADOSHA'
activities: studying and teaching of the vedas and vedangas

planetary.freeform: 13th Tithi starting in the 12th Tithi before midnight; 7th Tithi starting in the 6th Tithi before 1.5 Prahara in the night; 4th Tithi starting in the 3rd Tithi before 1 Prahara in the night

rules.notes: Studying and teaching of the Vedas and Vedangas are prohibited during these Naimittika Pradosha times.

rules.heading: SAMSKARA ACCORDING TO EACH VEDA: RIGAVEDIS UPANAYANA

planetary.freeform: Upanayana Samskara for Rigavedis

rules.notes: Upanayana for Rigavedis is auspicious in specified nakshatras including Mrigashira, Ardra, Ashlesha, Hasta, Chitra, Swati, Moola, and the three Poorvas.

rules.heading: SAMSKARA ACCORDING TO EACH VEDA: YAJURVEDIS UPANAYANA

planetary.freeform: Upanayana Samskara for Yajurvedis

rules.notes: Upanayana for Yajurvedis is auspicious in Revati, Hasta, Anuradha, Mrigashira, Punarvasu, Pushya, Rohini, and the three Uttaras.

rules.heading: SAMSKARA ACCORDING TO EACH VEDA: SAAMAVEDIS UPANAYANA

planetary.freeform: Upanayana Samskara for Saamavedis

rules.notes: Upanayana for Saamavedis is auspicious in Ashwini, Dhanishtha, Pushya, Hasta, the three Uttaras, Ardra, and Shravana.

rules.heading: SAMSKARA ACCORDING TO EACH VEDA: ATHARVAVEDIS UPANAYANA

planetary.freeform: Upanayana Samskara for Atharvavedis

rules.notes: Upanayana for Atharvavedis is auspicious in Mrigashira, Revati, Laghu nakshatras (Hasta, Ashwini, Pushya), Anuradha, Dhanishtha, and Punarvasu.

rules.heading: THE PACIFICATION RITE FOR THE AUSPICIOUS DEEDS IF THE CHILD'S MOTHER IS HAVING MENSES

planetary.freeform: If mother has menses after Nandi Shraddha and no proper lagna is available

rules.notes: Samskaras like mundana, upanayana, and marriage can proceed on the same day after a pacification rite if the mother has menses and no other lagna is available.

rules.heading: THE CHHURIKA BANDHANA MUHURTA FOR THE KSHATRIYAS

planetary.freeform: Months auspicious for Upanayana Samskara, excluding combust Mars

rules.notes: Chhurika Bandhana for Kshatriyas is auspicious in the months suitable for Upanayana, excluding Chaitra, Tuesday, and when Mars is combust.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE KESHANTA KARMA AND SAMAVARTANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Same Muhurta as auspicious for Mundana Samskara is auspicious for Keshanta Karma, and same Muhurta as auspicious for Upanayana Samskara is auspicious for Samavartana Karma.

rules.notes: Keshanta Karma uses the muhurta of Mundana, while Samavartana Karma uses the muhurta of Upanayana.
